fields.FIR_Description: As per the FIR recorded on 2025-04-11, the complainant reported suspicious activity near Sindhu Garden Residential Colony in Erode, where a person was allegedly handing over packets to visitors at night. The time of the incident was given as 20:15 on 2025-04-11. Nandhini Sekar approached Erode South PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000014. The complainant alleged that Jagan Raman may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000369. Abirami Sekar (9000000186) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. A further person, Elango Selvam, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000289, is stated to be associated with the incident. Another person, Balaji Karuppasamy, using the number 9000000407, was named as potentially involved. Potentially relevant material referenced includes a witness statement.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Repeated suspicious exchanges allegedly observed near a public place.
